documented behavior and actual behavior disagree: code.m2:263 says 'break -- leave the debugger, returning to top level', but break leaves the debugger and resumes the file past the failing expression. Four lines reproduce it -- load a file whose function calls error, then break, and the rest of the file runs. Distinct from #1928: continue re-runs the failing expression and loops, break skips it and continues, so the two commands differ and neither matches its description
